name: Jiajing Emperor
contribution: The 12th emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1521 to 1567.

checks.lead: The Jiajing Emperor (16 September 1507 – 23 January 1567), personal name Zhu Houcong, was the 12th emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1521 to 1567. He succeeded his cousin, the Zhengde Emperor.
